title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

reports.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

summary: Researchers linked a September 2026 influence campaign aimed at U.S. Democratic Senate candidates to the Russia-linked Matryoshka network, also called Operation Overload. The campaign reportedly used AI-cloned celebrity voices and fake videos styled as news to spread false or unsubstantiated claims on social media. Celebrities and CNN rejected the manipulated statements and the unauthorized use of their branding. The effort was meant to influence U.S. voters before the midterms.
